question: What kinematic viscosity at 40 °C and what flash point does the biodiesel produced over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 have?
rendered: The biodiesel produced over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 has a kinematic viscosity of 4.36 mm^2 s^−1 at 40 °C and a flash point of 168 °C.
